description: Two record types told apart by a signed zoned digit resolved under cp037 and the ebcdic convention -- F5 or C5 for +5, D5 for -5 -- read under ASCII with translated-EBCDIC signs. The sign byte is re-expressed by its column of the convention's table rather than by its value, so F5 arrives as 35 and C5 as 45, which is what a transfer writes, and the one-of keeps both.
source: docs/ir/SPEC.md, "Each axis carries a literal the way a file crosses it"; cobol-go codec/SPEC.md, "Zoned Sign Conventions"
